title: Filing an appeal to the Supreme Court
description: Appeal against an order made by the National Commission

steps.step: The person aggrieved by the order made by the National Commission prepares to file an appeal to the Supreme Court within thirty days from the date of the order
The person files the appeal to the Supreme Court within the specified period
If the appeal is filed after the expiry of thirty days, the Supreme Court considers whether there was sufficient cause for the delay
If the person is required to pay an amount in terms of the National Commission’s order, they must deposit fifty per cent of that amount as prescribed

documents: Proof of deposit of fifty per cent of the amount (if applicable)
